messages:
Jordan Lee: FYI scheduling a night maintenance for us-south1 GPU racks — Wed 01:30-04:30 UTC. Scope: rolling soft reboots + microcode sanity checks. No model restarts planned. Expect ~10% hit to 'ember' shared pool. Need a backfill plan + console banner.
Maya Singh: how many nodes per cohort? we should limit cross-az impact.
Ethan Cruz: Cohorts of 4 nodes every 15m per rack, spread across 3 racks. Ember has 160 nodes, Dedicated holds 32. Peak drop estimated ~9-11%.
Jordan Lee: we'll do a canary cohort at 01:30, wait 12m, run probes, then continue. ops runbook will auto-run cache warm after each cohort.
Maya Singh: recommend seeding prefix/KV and embedding cache. I'll place a seed file in `s3://infra-seeds/ember/7d-top-prefixes.json`.
Ethan Cruz: Backfill plan: prefer spot instances for 60% of burst, fall back to on-demand for the rest. Quick cost estimate: 8 on-demand GPUs * $2.8/hr * 3h = $67.2. Spots lower but volatile.
Maya Singh: also consider using a small Dedicated burst lane if customers on reserved plans need SLAs. That avoids noisy neighbor reclaim.
Jordan Lee: routing change: add temporary fallback to us-east1 for latency-sensitive routes. Ops: update route policy `route:ember` to include `fallback:us-east1` during window. Egress cost note: +$0.02/token estimate.
Ethan Cruz: eviction policy — we should respect `infra/preserve=true` annotation. Use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600` for normal pods. Long jobs get a 30m drain buffer if annotated.
Maya Singh: health probes: run `go run infra/cmd/probe --pool ember --check=95p` pre and post cohort. If 95p > 2x baseline, pause and alert oncall.
Jordan Lee: ops-bot, please schedule maintenance and ping oncall 15m before canary.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: us-south1-nightly-softreboot (6169994444). Window Wed 01:30-04:30 UTC. Notifications: #customers, #support, #gpucapacity.
oncall-bot: Will notify oncall at 01:15 UTC.
Ethan Cruz: runbook snippet for scroll:
```
# cordon + drain + seed
kubectl cordon gpu-node-101
kubectl drain gpu-node-101 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600
curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/seed-cache?pool=ember&scope=prefixes
# post-drain probe
go run infra/cmd/probe --pool ember --check=95p
```
Maya Singh: I'll monitor cache hit/miss and 95p in Grafana during the window. I'll also prepare a short customer banner copy.
Jordan Lee: please add console banner: "Planned maintenance in us-south1 — brief capacity impact; automatic fallback to us-east1 enabled." Post comms in #customer-commms once approved.
Ethan Cruz: staging dry-run tonight at 23:00 UTC using same cadence. I'll paste results here after.
Maya Singh: :thumbsup: tagging @finance for the burst approval.
Jordan Lee: thanks – closing thread for now, will reopen if we hit any blockers or probe failures.
